episodes.title: Tommy's Big Job
episodes.summary: In Mr. Pickles, the urban sprawl of modern society pollutes the old-fashioned town where the Goodman family lives with their lovable pet dog, Mr. Pickles, a deviant collie with a secret satanic streak. Tommy falls for a young farmer girl, but she's not interested in a man without a job. Tommy sets out to find a job

episodes.title: Father's Day Pie
episodes.summary: When Mr. Goodman's Father's Day pie goes missing, Tommy and Mr. Pickles set out searching for the pie thief, but meet an unexpected creature in the forest.

episodes.title: Foul Ball
episodes.summary: The Goodman's go to a baseball game, and Tommy hopes to catch a highly sought after, record breaking foul ball.

episodes.title: The Cheeseman
episodes.summary: The Goodmans go on a family camping trip and Tommy learns the frightening legend of The Cheeseman.

episodes.title: Dead Man's Curve
episodes.summary: Tommy enters the soapbox derby and Grandpa finds Mr. Pickles' biggest fear.

episodes.title: Loose Tooth
episodes.summary: Tommy sets out with Mr. Pickles to lose his tooth so he can meet the Tooth Fairy. Meanwhile, Sheriff searches for a group of wanted pedophiles.

episodes.title: Grandpa's Night Out
episodes.summary: Grandpa wakes up hungover and soon finds out that he made a horrible mistake the night before.

episodes.title: Coma
episodes.summary: Mr. Goodman wonders how easy his life would be if he were a dog, and when he gets knocked unconscious, he soon finds out.

episodes.title: Where is Mr. Pickles?
episodes.summary: Mr. Pickles gets dog-napped as a gang of bounty hunters race to collect the bounty on his head.

episodes.title: The Lair
episodes.summary: Grandpa goes on a quest to discover what really is happening inside Mr. Pickles' doghouse, and to prove once and for all that he is not crazy.

episodes.title: Mental Asylum
episodes.summary: Season one ended with Mr. Pickles causing Grandpa to be taken to the mental asylum. But when Mr. Pickles realizes Grandpa is now safe from him behind the asylum walls, he hatches a new plan to bust him out.

episodes.title: Cops and Robbers
episodes.summary: Tommy finds himself caught up in a big crime after mistaking a little person for a child his own age.

episodes.title: Serial Killers
episodes.summary: A prison bus full of serial killers are loose in Old Town, and Mr. Pickles is recruited as a K-9 cop.

episodes.title: Shövenpucker
episodes.summary: With a metal thief loose in Old Town, Tommy and Mr. Pickles seek the help of an old superhero with a strange addiction.

episodes.title: Fish?
episodes.summary: When a suspicious woman in town takes a romantic interest in Sheriff, Mr. Bojenkins sets out to reveal her true intentions.

episodes.title: A.D.D.
episodes.summary: This special episode of Mr. Pickles takes place in outer space with a dolphin and an evil shrimp.

episodes.title: My Dear Boy
episodes.summary: Tommy finds a half-deer half-boy animal, and has trouble trying to get him under control.

episodes.title: Vegans
episodes.summary: Beverly is invited to join a group of vegans at the Vegan Headquarters without the intentions of how to be a true vegan.

episodes.title: Talent Show
episodes.summary: Tommy's attempts to write jokes for the Old Town Talent Show lead him to cross paths with a mysterious old woman who lives in an old haunted house.

episodes.title: Mr. Pickles
episodes.summary: Grandpa finds an ancient and mysterious coin that he thinks has something to do with Mr. Pickles.

episodes.title: Brain Download
episodes.summary: Grandpa found his dead wife alive with Mr. Pickles. Now, Mr. Pickles' dark secrets are in jeopardy when Tommy attempts to download his Grandma's memories.

episodes.title: Momma's Boy
episodes.summary: When Mr. Bojenkins finds that Sheriff is a momma's boy, he decides to teach Sheriff how to be a man.

episodes.title: S.H.O.E.S.
episodes.summary: Tommy tries to protect a strange new friend from a military group that is out to capture him.

episodes.title: Telemarketers Are the Devil
episodes.summary: When Mr. Goodman and his co-workers are kidnapped from Telemarketing Corp., he winds up the property of a farm owner who has a vendetta against telemarketers.

episodes.title: Gorzoth
episodes.summary: When Linda goes on a shopping spree, she winds up on the run from a zombie-like mob of homeless people that want her money.

episodes.title: Tommy Goes to School
episodes.summary: Tommy teaches the kids at school that we're all the same, with some help from a giant pimple.

episodes.title: Sheriffs
episodes.summary: Sheriff searches for a birthday present for Momma while staring in his own television show.

episodes.title: Bullies
episodes.summary: When Mrs. Goodman confronts the parents of Tommy's bullies, they dump their out-of-control kids with her for the day.

episodes.title: Tommy's Cartoon
episodes.summary: Mr. Pickles goes on an adventure with the Sheriff. Tommy has fun exploring on his own and meets someone really weird.

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.summary: Grandpa is fed up Mr. Pickles and wants to leave the town but Mr. Pickles keeps interfering.

episodes.title: Mr. Prickles Presents The Tree of Flesh
episodes.summary: After Mr. Pickles framed Grandpa for murder in the Season 3 finale, Sheriff learns of Grandpa's whereabouts, and heads out of the country to track him down. Meanwhile Grandpa has a new determination to finally end things with Mr. Pickles.
